title: Progress window and busy guard
summary: ConvRulesEditor shows a cancellable progress window for long engine calls and refuses Save, Add, Convert and Delete while one runs
intro: Know why the editor shows a progress window and why a click was refused while it runs.

questions.ask: Why was my click on Convert or Save refused?
questions.command: A long engine call is running (progress window); wait for it or press Cancel, then repeat
